job.value: notice the 10.10 Home Services deals and book a flash deal

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The '10.10 Home Services MEGA DEAL' hero and 'S$10 Flash deals (10-14 Oct)' make the campaign plain.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The red 'Book now' on the 'Home cleaning S$10/hr' card is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Book now' and 'Share' say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Ongoing deal', 'Selling fast' and '49 left!' are everyday shopping terms.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing is asked except whether to book.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only the deal, price, timer and stock are shown; more deals scroll sideways.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Price, countdown and stock carry the card with no paragraph to read.
